mission: Settle admitted SNKRDUNK browser routes before context disposal

impacts.reason: A bounded browser admission lifecycle fix fences new requests and settles granted routes before SNKRDUNK closes its context; late source denials remain fatal. Only the existing SNKRDUNK staging collector receives the rebuilt shared component. No scheduling, routing, capacity or identity-policy change.

routes: SNKRDUNK existing singleton due-work consumer; admission/browser shutdown only
dependencies: Existing shared source budget, exact-print writer, source denial and singleton guards
impact.deployment_impact: Pinned staging API component and one existing SNKRDUNK collector; unchanged Yuyu component remains PR57.

recovery.procedure: Fix forward prior shared/collector source on the same pinned staging resources if lifecycle or admission invariants fail; retain all evidence and quarantines.
recovery.trigger: Unmetered dispatch, late required-denial loss, indefinite route settlement or unexpected identity/price writes
recovery.backup: No schema, queue, mapping, price or service-configuration mutation. Previous exact source and successful deployment retained.

verification.observation_window: After full adopted CI and serialized delivery, inspect the next ordinary scheduled SNKRDUNK turn and freshness attempts. Placeholder identities remain refused; no manual collector trigger.
